mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises by more than 0.5% in 3 consecutive months during a decline, or if 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1.5% signals rising manufacturing output, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO falls below 1.0% in the following month after triggering, or if 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% signals tighter monetary policy, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS falls below 0.3% in the following month after triggering, or if 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 0.3% in the following month after triggering, or if 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises above 0.0% in the following month after triggering, or if 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of triggered instances.
